meta.title: Speed Converter — Convert Meter/second and More
meta.description: Free speed converter for 6+ units including Meter/second, Kilometer/hour, Mile/hour. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: m/s, km/h, mph, knots. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 6 speed units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for speed in this tool is **mps**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most speed conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Meter/second | m/s |
| Kilometer/hour | km/h |
| Mile/hour | mph |
| Foot/second | ft/s |
| Knot | kn |
| Mach (sea level) | M |
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this speed converter?
**A:** It uses 6 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Meter/second (m/s), Kilometer/hour (km/h), Mile/hour (mph), Foot/second (ft/s), Knot (kn), Mach (sea level) (M).
